answer: The wander escrow holds each stake, the glacier settlement releases it, and the umber audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 16% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A farm running 148 keys therefore pays that exposure 148 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
